0022600211.text: The Knicks (5-4, on a three-game winning streak) host the Milwaukee Bucks (1-9, on a six-game losing streak) in a matchup that finds New York 3rd in the Atlantic and 5th in the East, while Milwaukee sits 15th in the East and 5.5 games back in the Central. New York won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27; their last meeting came on February 27 in Milwaukee, where the Knicks won 127-98. New York is missing Josh Hart, who is day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision after averaging 8.6 points and 31.7 minutes this season, while Milwaukee is without Gary Trent Jr. (illness) and Tyler Herro (knee bruise), both also day-to-day and game-time decisions.
